stem.en: Kabir raises the binding strength as far as it goes and the colony glows at ten cells. He says "that is better, it glows sooner". What has he built?

text.en: A colony that glows when it is useless. Ten cells cannot light a squid. The threshold is not "as low as possible"; it is set where the group is big enough for the job to pay.

feedback.en: Sooner is more coins spent on an invisible light. Tomorrow's cheater lesson is about who wins that game.

text.en: A colony that cannot stop glowing.

feedback.en: It can stop, if the cells are washed out. It just starts too early.

text.en: Nothing different; the squid glows anyway.

feedback.en: The squid's light comes from a million cells. Ten glowing cells make no light anyone can see.

explanation.en: A threshold tuned by evolution is set where the group action first pays. Move it and the colony spends at the wrong time.
